channel.title: Global News: BC 1 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global News: BC 1 (globalnews.ca)

item.title: EU will delay proposal to permanently ban Russian oil imports - National | Globalnews.ca
item.description: The U.S.-Israeli war on Iran is creating the biggest oil supply disruption in history, according to the International Energy Agency, sending global crude prices soaring.

item.title: U.K. police examine possible Iran link after Jewish charity ambulances torched - National | Globalnews.ca
item.description: A video posted on Telegram, allegedly by an Islamist group called Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamia, showed a map of where the ambulances were kept and footage of them on fire.

item.title: Iran vows to ‘completely’ close Strait of Hormuz if U.S. hits power plants - National | Globalnews.ca
item.description: Iran said the Strait of Hormuz would be 'completely closed' immediately if the U.S. follows up on President Donald Trump’s threat to attack its power plants.

item.title: Iran war a ‘disastrous mistake,’ says German president in rare rebuke - National | Globalnews.ca
item.description: The Iran war is a "disastrous mistake" that breaches international law, Germany's president said on Tuesday in a blunt rebuke of U.S. President Donald Trump's foreign policy

item.title: Bell on display outside Nova Scotia church stolen using grinder saw: police - Halifax | Globalnews.ca
item.description: RCMP are investigating the theft of an iron bell that was displayed outside a Nova Scotia church.

item.title: The Curator: 11 best Bluetooth speakers that’ll get your spring party started - National | Globalnews.ca
item.description: Need a portable speaker with pounding bass? Party-worthy light shows? The ability to float in a pool or survive a fall? From Beats to JBL, read on for our favourites.

item.title: Montreal Metropolitan Airport unveils new terminal, will open in June - Montreal | Globalnews.ca
item.description: Montreal Metropolitan Airport says its new terminal will open in a few months as it gets ready to welcome commercial flights.

item.title: Boxer Isis Sio out of medically induced coma 2 days after match knockout - National | Globalnews.ca
item.description: Isis Sio, 19, suffered injuries following her loss against Jocelyn Camarillo, 21, just 78 seconds into the first round of their fight on March 21.

item.title: Four premiers ask for greater say in superior, appeal court judge appointments | Globalnews.ca
item.description: Four premiers are jointly calling on the federal government to give them more of a say in judges who are appointed to their superior and appeal courts.

item.title: B.C. considering changes to weaken DRIPA, shares confidential letter with First Nations leaders | Globalnews.ca
item.description: The bill, known as DRIPA, requires B.C. to take "all measures" to align the rights of Indigenous Peoples with existing provincial legislation.
